title: 1056: Convince us that Effect.ts is good
summary:
Scott and Wes sit down with Michael Arnaldi to dig into Effect v4 and why guardrails matter now that AI agents are writing so much of our code. They discuss going zero dependencies, a 5x smaller bundle, FoldKit, Alchemy, Effect Cluster and workflows, and observability by default.

title: 1055: What the hell is going on with GitHub?
summary:

Plus Copilot Fusion’s cascade and critique modes, npm supply chain security, and whether pull requests are dead.

title: 1054: Reddit Closing it’s Doors
summary:
Wes, Scott, and CJ are back with two weeks of news: Reddit is forcing everyone to log in, r/opensource bans anything AI, and CSS-Tricks is independent again. Plus Anomaly's Hex dictation app, Mitchell Hashimoto's Rex terminal, TanStack Redact, Cloudflare's TypeScript port to Rust, Vercel's Agent Desktop, the new touchscreen MacBook Pros, a flood of CVEs, and a certificate authority whose private key was the number 4.
